title: SSG Harmony Friday Party: The force behind entertainment and employee connection via Hybrid systems
image1Description: Controlling lighting, sound, and live streaming systems to create the SSG Harmony party atmosphere

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: The Friday Party, under the theme SSG Harmony, was organized to provide relaxation and strengthen relationships among employees within the corporate group. My intention as a technical staff member was to make this event a space of happiness accessible to all employees simultaneously, whether they were in the main banquet hall or following via the online system from various branches nationwide.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as the 'Show Controller,' managing all behind-the-scenes operations. This included designing and controlling stage lighting, managing Music Playback to match the mood of each segment, and most importantly, overseeing the online streaming system to ensure employees at various locations and provincial branches experienced crisp visuals and audio as if they were physically present. Additionally, I coordinated the cues for award ceremonies and various kick-off activities to ensure they proceeded precisely according to the schedule.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was managing 'Troubleshooting' issues that can arise at any moment during a live event, such as adjusting audio cues to fit on-stage situations or maintaining the stability of the streaming signal. My team and I had to remain on High Alert to ensure every sequence followed the plan and were ready to resolve immediate issues instantly without disrupting the participants' enjoyment.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: The event proceeded smoothly and received excellent feedback from employees. This experience strengthened my 'Live Production' and 'Agile Problem Solving' skills. I learned the art of behind-the-scenes work, which requires meticulous attention to detail and seamless team coordination to deliver a memorable experience to a large audience simultaneously.
